title: SAVIOR: Sample-efficient Adaptation of Vision-Language Models for OCR Representation
abstract: arXiv:2611.27319v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) pipelines and vision-language models exhibit high accuracy on standard OCR and document-understanding benchmarks, yet they systematically underperform on document patterns that are operationally critical in financial workflows. These patterns include vertical or rotated text, logo-embedded vendor names, fine-print regulatory clauses, degraded scans, and complex multi-column layouts. While underrepresented in public datasets, they constitute a substantial portion of real-world failure cases. We introduce SAVIOR, a sample-efficient data curation methodology that targets such high-impact failure scenarios to adapt vision-language models for robust financial OCR. We further propose PaIRS, a structure-aware evaluation metric that measures layout fidelity by comparing pairwise spatial relationships between tokens. translated_title: SAVIOR：面向OCR表示的视觉-语言模型样本高效自适应方法
translated_abstract: 光学字符识别（OCR）流程与视觉-语言模型在标准OCR和文档理解基准测试中表现出较高的准确率，但在金融工作流程中具有关键业务意义的文档模式上却系统性地表现不佳。这些模式包括竖排或旋转文本、嵌入徽标的供应商名称、小字号法规条款、退化的扫描件以及复杂的多栏布局。尽管这些模式在公开数据集中代表性不足，但它们在实际应用失败案例中占据了相当大的比例。我们提出SAVIOR，一种针对此类高影响失败场景的样本高效数据整理方法，用于使视觉-语言模型适应稳健的金融OCR。我们进一步提出PaIRS，一种结构感知的评估指标，通过比较词符之间的成对空间关系来衡量布局保真度。使用SAVIOR-Train对Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct进行微调，达到了0.93的词召回率。（注：原始摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出样本高效的数据整理方法SAVIOR和结构感知评估指标PaIRS，通过微调Qwen2.5-VL使视觉语言模型在金融OCR的关键失败场景（如竖排/旋转文本、徽标嵌入名称、退化扫描件和多栏布局）上实现0.93的词召回率。
